Question 9
?

Which of the following statements is true regarding the series ∑n=4∞(−0.3)n ?

a
The series is divergent because |r|<1.
b
The series is convergent because |r|≥1.
c
Inconclusive because |r|=1.
d
The series is convergent because |r|<1.
e
The series is divergent because |r|≥1.
